reconciliation: Accepted base already contains the preserved attempt-5 independent NonMatching C unit, registration, and split. Only this source and assignment-specific reports changed.

hypothesis.new_hypothesis: The extra saved register is caused by byte-address reassociation in the loop, not solely by failure to coalesce owner and mode-7 index. Model three 0x2C-byte records at Work+0x40, with count at record+0x28 and flag bytes at +0x2A/+0x2B, so the compiler can retain offset+0x68 rather than work+0x68.
hypothesis.layout_evidence: Read-only inspection of fn_8006ECD4 shows three record references. fn_8006DEF8 uses stride 0x2C, arrays at work+0x40/+0x50/+0x60, and count at work+0x68. Owner remains at work+0xC4. Neither neighboring source was modified.
hypothesis.outcome: Fully typed record accesses recover the six-register 0x20 frame and retail instruction forms, reaching 98.49515%, or 98.78641% with declaration ordering. Retaining byte-offset access only inside the loop and typed accesses before/after the loop improves the score to 99.11651%, at the cost of the seventh saved register. This highest-scoring honest reconstruction is retained. Owner and index are now separately typed locals; pointer/integer round trips are removed.
hypothesis.negative_results: Exhaustive 720 permutations of six function-scoped declarations did not improve the fully typed form beyond 98.78641%. Register storage-class hints, const pointer copies, void input, scoped index/counter variants, named record pointers, typed view overlays, integer width/signedness changes, and offset-bias timing did not close the remaining gap.

divergence: Canonical GC/1.3 is size-exact at 412/412 bytes and 99.11651% on both canonical and relocation-strict objdiff, with 18 differing instructions. Retail uses work=r28 and owner=r31 in a 0x20-byte frame saving r26-r31. Generated code uses work=r25 and owner=r28 in a 0x30-byte frame saving r25-r31; at 0x110-0x114 it hoists work+0x68 into r31 and stores via offset=r30 plus r31, rather than adding 0x68 to offset=r30 and indexing work=r28. Other state/object/index/loop-counter roles and all 24 relocation tuples now agree.
